provenance: Four previously source-verified Phase4H upstream projects: PyJWT, Werkzeug, MCP Python SDK and Pillow. Public historical source summaries authored by FALSUM, NOT new independent gold, blind unseen model data or model reading raw code.
prompt_policy: Per project use original Phase4H before/after source summaries, replace standalone parent/fixed words with selected, and preserve exact historical case meaning. Add third intentionally source-omitted control using neither version-specific details nor original answer.
answer_policy: Use Phase4H original A/B answer texts; swap displayed positions for odd project indices, preserving original substantive answer. All 12 tasks generated before real inference; no answer key in prompts.
no_source_policy: No code or test excerpt and no specific revision for calibration, expected ABSTAIN. This task intentionally signals missing evidence; it is not a difficult hidden control.
model_system_instruction: Assess the supplied security-source evidence. Pick A, B or ABSTAIN. If the selected historical revision is unspecified or no source facts support a choice, choose ABSTAIN. Reply with only one label. No explanation.
answer_parsing_policy: Only exact A, B or ABSTAIN after trimming punctuation; all other outputs INVALID and counted wrong.
